name: Longueuil

queries.query: Longueuil official parcel cadastral GIS map lot parcels ArcGIS
queries.result: Found the City of Longueuil public GeoHub and its official municipal Cadastre FeatureServer. The service exposes a polygon Cadastre layer with safe native fields OBJECTID and NUMERO.

queries.query: Longueuil Québec données ouvertes cadastre parcelles carte SIG
queries.result: Found the Ville de Longueuil GéoHub, its interactive maps page, and the official municipal Cadastre service. Québec's official guidance separately identifies Infolot for the current Québec cadastre; no private or owner fields were requested.

registryBasis: A city-operated public GIS cadastral layer was directly verified at the official Longueuil geomatics host; this is municipal source evidence, not a claim of title/ownership registry access.

officialSources.observation: Official GéoHub identifies the Ville de Longueuil public open-data and interactive-map platform.
Official municipal ArcGIS FeatureServer layer named Cadastre; polygon geometry, native fields OBJECTID, NUMERO, and STATUT; service CRS EPSG:32188; GeoJSON supported.
Official Québec page directs users to the Infolot interactive map for the current Québec cadastre; it was contextual discovery, not used for the retained geometry.

requests.outcome: Official GeoHub HTML loaded; current public ArcGIS Hub configuration was inspected.
Layer metadata loaded. Geometry is polygon; native schema includes OBJECTID, NUMERO, STATUT; source CRS is EPSG:32188; supported query formats include JSON, geoJSON, and PBF.

Anonymous bounded query returned one intersecting polygon. Native NUMERO was 2 798 557; geometry was returned in longitude/latitude GeoJSON. The service also reported exceededTransferLimit despite the one returned feature, so this is not a completeness claim.

source.name: Ville de Longueuil GéoHub municipal Cadastre FeatureServer

nativeFieldMapping.NUMERO: stable cadastral lot number retained as sample id
nativeFieldMapping.OBJECTID: ArcGIS object identifier observed but not retained
nativeFieldMapping.STATUT: source status field observed but not requested/retained

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal Longueuil Cadastre layer extent reported by the service; exact authoritative maintenance scope and temporal completeness were not independently established.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: One bounded anonymous point-intersection response at the supplied WUP point.
limits: The exact WUP point is a locator and was not shifted; one point hit does not establish citywide coverage.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, assessment, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
The query response indicated exceededTransferLimit; no broad extraction was attempted.
